description: Field-by-field diff of TWO markets' settlement clauses (one from each of `a` and `b`; either can be Polymarket .com, Polymarket US, or Kalshi) — runs resolution_audit on both sides and compares source, settle time, precision, comparison_basis, and evidence standard. Returns `equivalent`: "true" only when both sides parsed with enough confidence to compare AND no field conflicts; "false" when a specific conflict was found (differing_fields names which — e.g. ["source","settle_time"] for a Polymarket Bitcoin market settling on Binance's 1-minute candle at noon ET versus a Kalshi KXBTCD market settling on CF Benchmarks' BRTI 60-second average at 5pm EDT — SAME asset, DIFFERENT contract; or ["source","precision"] for Polymarket.com's Chainlink 15-minute TWAP clause (precision "twap_60s_lookback") against Kalshi's 15-minute KXBTC15M clause (precision "60-second trailing average" off CF Benchmarks' BRTI) — different source and a different lookback mechanism, even though BOTH compare an end-of-window average to a start-of-window average, so comparison_basis is EQUAL there and correctly NOT in differing_fields — verified live 2026-10-22, fleet #3447); "unclear" when one or both sides could not be confidently parsed (an absence of evidence is not evidence of equivalence — read raw_clause yourself in that case). comparison_basis is flagged as differing whenever both sides resolved one and they disagree, independent of whether source/precision also matched. Only flags source/evidence_standard as differing when BOTH sides gave a SPECIFIC comparable answer — a named source (e.g. "Associated Press, Fox News, NBC") against a generic one (e.g. Kalshi's "consensus of media organizations") is treated as the same evidence standard, not a conflict, since that is standard election-market boilerplate on both venues. Use this before sizing a polymarket_kalshi_spread pair as a real cross-venue arb, or standalone to sanity-check any two markets you suspect settle on different things.
name: resolution_diff
title: Resolution Diff
